legacy.finding: Page start is fired inside a delayed callback after startup; timer is mechanism, not readiness contract.
Numeric _onBuilt schedules a timeout from an after-build callback; its execution is not a page-readiness barrier.
Lazy children wait for visibility or _buildNow before lazyBuildFinalize; page startup need not await them.

current.finding: Fetch, loadSource and Application construction precede inspector setup; no unified ready lifecycle.

bootstrap_readiness.expected: Page startup must distinguish initial non-lazy construction and after-build scheduling from delayed provider execution and lazy subtree construction. Delayed _onBuilt callbacks and initially hidden lazy children must not block global startup. Exact readiness participation and public hook timing are Macro 2 planning decisions; the legacy fixed timer is not the new contract.
bootstrap_readiness.reason: Replace the historical fixed delay with explicit completion.
bootstrap_readiness.verification: Record initial construction, immediate and delayed _onBuilt callbacks, and page onStart separately. Include an _onBuilt delay longer than startup and an initially hidden lazy child: startup must not wait for either; revealing the child builds its subtree without repeating page startup. Settle exact immediate-hook ordering in Macro 2 before implementation.
bootstrap_readiness.validation: Source inspection only; verification describes future conformance checks unless explicitly recorded elsewhere.

legacy.finding: Construction callback is extracted from node attributes; recipe context is distinct from widget methods.

current.finding: Actions execute with the source node as this; provider engine uses a separate path.

source_callback_context.expected: Action and supported provider callbacks receive their source node and freshly evaluated parameters.
source_callback_context.verification: Invoke an action and controller after changing a bound parameter; record this, resolved values and relative writes.
source_callback_context.validation: Source inspection only; verification describes future conformance checks unless explicitly recorded elsewhere.

legacy.finding: Reads resolve through absDatapath; legacy getRelativeData includes autocreate and default arguments.

current.finding: Relative resolution exists, but the second argument is defaultValue, not legacy autocreate.

relative_paths.expected: Preserve relative authoring paths; enumerate unsupported anchors and argument differences before exposing aliases.
relative_paths.reason: Keep options explicit internally; compatibility adapters must not reinterpret positional arguments silently.
relative_paths.verification: Test nested datapaths, absolute paths, attribute paths and supported anchors; compare missing-anchor behavior.
relative_paths.validation: Source inspection only; verification describes future conformance checks unless explicitly recorded elsewhere.

legacy.finding: PUT expands to setRelativeData with reason false; GET/SET/FIRE have separate expansions.
Fired write is followed by a null write with doTrigger false.

current.finding: Methods exist; RecipeRuntime does not compile legacy statement macros.

get_set_put_fire.expected: GET reads, SET notifies, PUT writes silently, FIRE emits then resets silently; strings/comments stay literal.
get_set_put_fire.reason: Use token-aware compilation instead of legacy regular expressions.
get_set_put_fire.verification: Count notifications for repeated FIRE including false and zero; verify reset and PUT silence; include macro text in strings and comments.
get_set_put_fire.validation: Source inspection only; verification describes future conformance checks unless explicitly recorded elsewhere.

legacy.finding: Widget methods are connected when present, otherwise target.domNode is used.

current.finding: Current command delegation handles button actions; it is not generic legacy connect.

method_and_dom_connections.expected: Distinguish native event listening from widget method observation; callback owner and disconnect are explicit.
method_and_dom_connections.reason: Avoid prototype patching; preserve observable ordering through tested widget adapters.
method_and_dom_connections.verification: Observe one DOM event and one widget method with arguments; disconnect and destroy owner; assert no later callback.
method_and_dom_connections.validation: Source inspection only; verification describes future conformance checks unless explicitly recorded elsewhere.

legacy.finding: Node topics are prefixed; subscription callback context and subscriber ownership may differ.

current.finding: Local listeners support unsubscribe and AbortSignal; declarative subscribers are walked from live source.

owned_topics.expected: Keep genro publish/subscribe and distinguish global page topics from node-prefixed topics and lifetime owner.
owned_topics.reason: Centralize owner cleanup rather than rely on detached DOM removal.
owned_topics.verification: Use two pages and two node owners with identical topic names; remove one owner and ensure only its subscriptions stop.
owned_topics.validation: Source inspection only; verification describes future conformance checks unless explicitly recorded elsewhere.

legacy.finding: Deletion invokes hooks, removes widgets/external widgets and recursively cleans subscriptions.

current.finding: Application has no unified dispose method; component disconnect and inspector cleanup are local.

recursive_deletion.expected: Source deletion cleans descendants once; DOM replacement retaining a source node is not source disposal.
recursive_deletion.reason: Make ownership explicit and cleanup idempotent.
recursive_deletion.verification: Delete parent source, count descendant cleanup, publish afterward, and repeat disposal without duplicate callbacks.
recursive_deletion.validation: Source inspection only; verification describes future conformance checks unless explicitly recorded elsewhere.

legacy.finding: Legacy index entry is removed only when it still points to the deleting node.

current.finding: Lookup walks current source by node_id and throws when missing.

node_id_reuse.expected: Reusing a node ID resolves to the new live node; old cleanup cannot remove new ownership.
node_id_reuse.verification: Remove a node, insert another with the same ID, complete old deferred cleanup and verify lookup and event target.
node_id_reuse.validation: Source inspection only; verification describes future conformance checks unless explicitly recorded elsewhere.

legacy.finding: Delayed writes use setTimeout bound to the node; this path does not cancel itself on removal.

current.finding: Clipboard clears its timer and increments a generation to ignore stale async completion.

pending_callback_cleanup.expected: Destroyed owners cannot apply late results; distinguish cancellation from ignoring an already running operation.
pending_callback_cleanup.reason: This strengthens legacy lifetime safety and extends the existing clipboard guard to owned services.
pending_callback_cleanup.verification: Start deferred write/result, destroy owner, resolve it, and assert no data/DOM/topic side effect on a replacement.
pending_callback_cleanup.validation: Source inspection only; verification describes future conformance checks unless explicitly recorded elsewhere.

legacy.finding: Each child window has its own genro, traversed by parent close notification.

current.finding: Existing test constructs two Applications and verifies topic and relative-data isolation.

page_instance_isolation.expected: Each page owns independent data, source and services; internal code receives owner rather than window.genro.
page_instance_isolation.verification: Construct two runtimes in one document; mutate and publish in one; verify the other is unchanged and survives first disposal.
page_instance_isolation.validation: Source inspection only; verification describes future conformance checks unless explicitly recorded elsewhere.

legacy.finding: XML decoding converts typed text with convertFromText and recursively constructs nested Bags using the supplied class dictionary.
The class dictionary maps domsource to GnrDomSource and bag to GnrBag; this distinguishes reconstructed source and ordinary Bags.
RPC responses are decoded into a Bag envelope with fromXmlDoc(response, genro.clsdict). This is legacy XML evidence, not TYTX compatibility evidence.

current.finding: Existing codec bridge asserts SourceBag, ordinary Bag, Decimal, date, attributes and bytes; no real socket is tested.

typed_source_data_transport.expected: Source and data remain distinct typed trees through JSON and MessagePack; inspector reads live Bags.
typed_source_data_transport.reason: Use TYTX rather than legacy XML transport while preserving types and structure.
typed_source_data_transport.verification: Run Python-to-JS rendering in both transports and typed-envelope test; assert subtree type, order, attributes and data edits.
typed_source_data_transport.validation: Source inspection only; verification describes future conformance checks unless explicitly recorded elsewhere.

legacy.finding: Close recursively notifies child genro, conditionally sends beacon and publishes onClosePage.

current.finding: Current bootstrap exposes one Application; no root/child transport or registered identity lifecycle.

page_close_and_nested_frames.expected: Root alone owns physical socket; each child owns identity/lifetime; close notification is best-effort and server expiry remains necessary.
page_close_and_nested_frames.reason: Requires approved ASGI identity/channel lifecycle; do not invent handshake or registry semantics.
page_close_and_nested_frames.verification: With approved transport seam, close one nested child then root; assert channel cleanup, origin validation and surviving siblings.
page_close_and_nested_frames.validation: Source inspection only; verification describes future conformance checks unless explicitly recorded elsewhere.

legacy.finding: Legacy patches Dojo moveables for touch and uses explicit handles.
Mobile draggable rows insert a 23px handle column; fillDragInfo routes it as row drag.
Drop callbacks run in source-node scope; inspected drag callbacks do not uniformly bind it.

current.finding: Palette has pointer cancellation handling; device parity must be checked beyond source inspection.

mobile_handles_and_cancellation.expected: Touch handles, keyboard alternatives and scroll/zoom remain usable; cancelled gestures release ownership.
mobile_handles_and_cancellation.reason: Use capability-driven pointer handling rather than touch-device globals and prototype patches.
mobile_handles_and_cancellation.verification: On hybrid and touch devices drag/resize from handle, scroll body, cancel pointer, rotate and use keyboard; assert no stuck drag or lost scrolling. Include second pointer, lost capture, removal during drag, typed internal drop and native file drop as distinct cases.
mobile_handles_and_cancellation.validation: Source inspection only; verification describes future conformance checks unless explicitly recorded elsewhere.
